law: ONE FLEET, MANY VENUES, ONE DOCTRINE BOOK: every venue keeps its own fee constants and every cross-venue route prices each leg by the venue it stands on. The cross-layer C1 check no longer reads two different FEE_BPS as un-arbitrated drift — it reads THIS book. Drift verdict returns the day this book's numbers stop matching the measured sources, or a venue changes its doctrine without a row here.
arbitrationRule: price-each-venue-by-its-own-doctrine — a route leg on the internal DEX charges kernel FEE_BPS, a leg on the EVM hub charges SAOSExchange FEE_BPS, the chains-side internal markets charge zero trade fee and keep the market-grid spacing floor as the maker economics guard. No leg may quote another venue's fee.

venues.feeBpsSourceNote: per-swap input fee; TREASURY_CUT_PCT of it routes to the fleet treasury
per-swap input fee; POT_SHARE_BPS of it routes to the protocol pot
the chains charge zero trade fee; the 40bps spacing floor is maker economics, not a fee

whyNotOneNumber: kernel 30bps funds the DEX treasury cut (30%); SAOSExchange 20bps funds the EVM pot (10bps) — the two venues have different treasuries and different settlement layers. Forcing one number would either starve a treasury or overcharge a venue. The law is per-venue pricing with a documented book, not forced equality.
